title: Databases Registry
description: Configuration for all supported databases, versions, and platforms

_generated.description: Marker indicating this file is generated from databases.yml

databases.description: Map of database IDs to their configuration

spindbStatus.description: SpinDB build status: completed (released on GitHub), in-progress (actively building)

commercialUse.description: Whether the license permits commercial use in applications, local dev, and internal use

hostedServiceAllowed.description: Whether the license permits offering this database as a hosted/managed service (DBaaS). False for SSPL, RSALv2, BSL-1.1, CSL, and similar source-available licenses that restrict competing cloud services.

dependencies.description: Runtime dependencies on other database engines

versions.description: Map of version strings to enabled status (boolean) or version config (object with overrides)

platforms.description: Platforms supported by this engine. Versions inherit this unless they specify their own platforms list.

VersionEntry.description: Either a boolean (enabled/disabled) or a VersionConfig object with overrides

VersionConfig.description: Version configuration with optional overrides for engine-level defaults. Object entries are enabled by default (set enabled: false to disable).

enabled.description: Whether this version is enabled for building/releasing. Defaults to true for object entries.

platforms.description: Override engine-level platforms. Array form: simple list of supported platforms. Object form: per-platform config where each key is a platform and value is true (inherit defaults) or an object with dependencies/cliTools overrides.

Dependency.description: Runtime dependency on another database engine

database.description: Database ID this engine depends on

cascadeDelete.description: If true, deleting this engine also removes the dependency (e.g., ferretdb removes postgresql-documentdb). If false, the dependency remains as a standalone engine (e.g., questdb leaves postgresql intact).

PlatformList.description: List of supported platform IDs. Presence in the array means supported.

PlatformMap.description: Map of platform IDs to their config. Keys are platforms, values are true (supported, inherits defaults) or a PlatformConfig object with overrides.

PlatformConfig.description: Per-platform overrides for a version. Each field fully replaces the version-level or engine-level default.

cliTools.description: Override CLI tools for this platform

runtime.description: Whether the database runs as a server process or is embedded/file-based

defaultPort.description: Default TCP port (null for embedded databases)

scheme.description: URI scheme for connection strings (e.g., postgresql, mysql, redis); null for embedded libraries

defaultDatabase.description: Default database name (e.g., 'postgres', '0' for Redis, null for embedded)

queryLanguage.description: Primary query language or API (API = native language bindings)

server.description: Server binary name (null for embedded databases)

client.description: Client CLI binary name (null for HTTP-only APIs)

enhanced.description: Recommended enhanced CLI tools (e.g., pgcli, mycli)
